thread.title: New downtown Sarasota restaurant serves Mediterranean flavors

author: Kendal Asbury
title: New downtown Sarasota restaurant serves Mediterranean flavors
text: DININGNew downtown Sarasota restaurant serves Mediterranean flavors Kendal AsburyUpdated Sept. 16, 2026, 5:21 p.m. ETBaldoria, a new restaurant and cocktail bar at 1528 Main St. in downtown Sarasota, serves shareable plates, specialty drinks and Mediterranean-inspired dishes. Read the full story.Kendal Asbury / Sarasota Herald-TribuneBaldoria Sarasota features flavors and plates from several different cuisines, including a tapas assortment that pulls from the Mediterranean, with Italian and Spanish twists. Other menu items span focaccia sandwiches, craft pasta plates and specialty pizzas.Provided By Baldoria SarasotaOwners of Baldoria Sarasota said that the decoration seen throughout the restaurant and the curated atmosphere is reflective of the owners’ heritage or travels, in that “every detail tells a small part of our story.”Provided By Baldoria SarasotaBaldoria Sarasota, a locally owned restaurant that takes inspiration from European flavors, offers focaccia sandwiches as a menu staple, including The Pig & The Artichoke, Salmson Says and Serrano & Brivido.Provided By Baldoria SarasotaIn addition to its culturally inspired craft plates, Baldoria Sarasota offers a self-pour beer and wine system with 24 taps of craft beverages, as well as a full, handcrafted cocktail service.Provided By Baldoria SarasotaBaldoria Sarasota features flavors and plates from several different cuisines, including a tapas assortment, focaccia sandwiches, specialty pizzas and craft pasta plates — including Carnival Lasagna and Timballino Siciliano.Provided By Baldoria SarasotaBaldoria, a new Sarasota restaurant, is named after the Italian word that encapsulates celebration and spending quality time with good company. “The idea is not only to come for dinner, but also to stop by for a cocktail and a tapa, share several dishes with friends, enjoy a bottle of wine, or simply spend the evening with us,” the owners said.Provided By Baldoria SarasotaBaldoria Sarasota features an extensive tapas menu, but also craft, shareable entrees like their signature pizzas — including Surf, Turf & Truffle.Provided By Baldoria SarasotaBaldoria Sarasota, a Mediterranean restaurant and cocktail bar, just opened along Main Street earlier this month, bringing shareable plates, specialty beverages and culturally inspired flavors to downtown Sarasota.Provided By Baldoria SarasotaA Mediterranean restaurant and cocktail bar, Baldoria Sarasota, brands itself as a "Famous kitchen. Rebel bar." The spot offers a self-pour beer and wine system with 24 taps of craft beverages, as well as a full, handcrafted cocktail service.Provided By Baldoria SarasotaBaldoria, which just opened in Sarasota's downtown corridor, is a new restaurant, bar and social space. Co-owner Paola Pignata said that "we designed Baldoria to feel lively and social, but still centered around food, conversation and the experience of being together.”Provided By Baldoria SarasotaBaldoria, a new restaurant and bar, recently opened this month in the former Block 15 Cork & Craft space, adding a full liquor and cocktail service to the former wine bar space.Provided By Baldoria SarasotaBaldoria Sarasota, a new locally owned business that opened along Main Street, features cocktail flavors that pulls from the Mediterranean, with Italian and Spanish twists.Provided By Baldoria SarasotaBaldoria Sarasota, which just opened at 1528 Main Street, features a menu drawing from the owners' shared Italian heritage and other traditions or flavors they encountered — and fell in love with — during their travels, including the Spanish way of sharing plates and the vibrancy of Mediterranean flavors.Kendal Asbury / Sarasota Herald-TribuneA man studies the menu posted on the window outside of Baldoria, a recently opened restaurant in downtown Sarasota, on Sept. 15. The menu features a Mediterranean concept with Spanish and Italian twists.Kendal Asbury / Sarasota Herald-TribuneBaldoria, a new restaurant and cocktail bar at 1528 Main St. in downtown Sarasota, serves shareable plates, specialty drinks and Mediterranean-inspired dishes.
